title: Each type in the family group chat
caption:
Every family group chat has the same 16 members. You know exactly who's who.

The one who uses full stops. The one who sends 47 voice notes before 9 am. The one who muted the group in 2021 and still knows everything. And the admin who renamed it 'Khandan Forever'.

Send this to the family group and see who recognises themselves first.

Which one are you, honestly?
